title: AutoML-Agent: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Full-Pipeline AutoML

model.params_source: assumed (paper silent; Appendix B.3 only names the model); the paper's five-run standard deviations imply sampling, see open_points

task.subset_rule: all (14 Table-3 datasets x 5 completions each, as in Table 6)
task.approximation: execution-based success rate needs a Python runtime with the 14 public datasets downloaded from the Table 5 sources (Kaggle, UCI, TSLib, Planetoid) and hand-graded on the 0 / 0.5 / 1.0 scale; runtime, package versions and dataset downloads differ from the authors' environment; only the text-classification skeleton script is printed, the other six task skeletons must be written in the same style

items.source: Table 3 (14 user instructions, constraint-free setting) with dataset links in Appendix B.2 / Table 5 and the skeleton script of Appendix B.1

fields.input: Table 3 instruction prompt for the dataset
fields.dataset: Table 5 / B.2 source (Kaggle dataset or competition, UCI id 856, thuml/Time-Series-Library, Planetoid Cora/Citeseer)
fields.skeleton: full-pipeline skeleton script for the task type (B.1 prints only text classification)
fields.label: execution grade 0 / 0.5 / 1.0 (Appendix B.4)

items.license: per dataset (Table 5: CC0, Custom, CC BY 4.0, Apache 2.0, MIT, N/A)

prompt.user_template:
You are a helpful intelligent assistant. Now please help solve the following machine learning task.
[Task]
{user_instruction}
[{file_name}.py] ```python
{full_pipeline_skeleton_script}
```
Start the python code with "```python". Please ensure the completeness of the code so that it can be run without additional modifications.

placeholders.full_pipeline_skeleton_script: the B.1 skeleton for the task type (only text classification is printed verbatim; others to be written)

prompt.source_location: Appendix B.3 'Zero-Shot Prompt for GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 Baselines'; instructions in Table 3; skeleton in Appendix B.1
prompt.verbatim: partial (prompt text verbatim with the extraction's ''' fences restored to ```; six of the seven skeleton scripts are not printed)

output.postprocess: run the script in a fresh environment with the dataset in place; grade 0.00 (does not execute), 0.50 (runnable ML/DL model), 1.00 (runnable model plus an accessible deployment endpoint, e.g. Gradio)

metric.name: custom
metric.definition: success rate: mean of the 0/0.5/1.0 execution grades over the 70 runs (14 datasets x 5 completions), Appendix B.4
metric.original_location: Table 6, constraint-free block, row GPT-4, column Avg.

open_points: no hook: the metric is execution-based (run each generated script in a Python/PyTorch+GPU runtime with the 14 datasets downloaded, 5 of them via Kaggle credentials, check a Gradio endpoint) with a manual 0 / 0.5 / 1.0 judgement - an execution sandbox plus human grading.
six of the seven task skeleton scripts are not printed (only text classification, Appendix B.1).
decoding: the five-run standard deviations imply sampling (default temperature 1.0) rather than the staged temperature 0; a human must pick one.
Table 3 rows for Weather/Electricity and Cora/Citeseer instructions are swapped in the extraction; use the instruction whose text names the dataset.
notes: API cost is negligible (~1.5K input + 1.5K output tokens per call); the effort is the execution environment. The claim is the zero-shot GPT-4 baseline, not the AutoML-Agent headline (needs the unreleased LoRA-tuned prompt agent).
